tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Lists the services this business offers (length, price) and which providers offer each one. Call this first to get the service_id and provider_id that the other tools need.

tools.name: find_open_slots
tools.description: Finds open start times for one service over a range of days, across every provider who offers it or just one. Times are in the time zone of each provider, given in the result. Use this before booking or rescheduling.

tools.name: find_customer
tools.description: Searches customers by name, email or phone and returns up to 10 matches with their customer_id. If several people match, ask which one is meant before booking.

tools.name: list_appointments
tools.description: Lists appointments for a customer, a provider and/or a date range, earliest first. Give at least one of customer_id, provider_id or date_from. Without dates it shows the next 30 days.

tools.name: book_appointment
tools.description: Books an appointment for an existing customer (customer_id) or a new one (new_customer). Two steps: first call without confirm to get a preview and show it to the person; only after they agree, call again with the same arguments, confirm: true, the confirmation_token from the preview and an idempote

tools.name: reschedule_appointment
tools.description: Moves an appointment to a new start time, optionally with another provider who offers the same service. tools.name: cancel_appointment
tools.description: Cancels an upcoming appointment. Easy!Appointments deletes it and emails the customer a cancellation notice; this cannot be undone. Two steps: call without confirm for a preview, then, after the person agrees, again with confirm: true, the confirmation_token from the preview and an idempotency_key.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: book_appointment · Public sink: find_customer.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: book_appointment · Public sink: find_customer

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
